target_customer: Pharma and biotech partners for cell and gene therapy, and ultimately cancer patients
problem: First generation CAR-T has toxicity, exhaustion and limited solid tumor reach; the company designs synthetic receptors and delivery vehicles to address this.
business_model: Preclinical platform company seeking partnerships and licensing
product_category: Cell and gene therapy platform (MARC receptors, MoVe delivery vector)

founders.name: David White
education: PhD (university not stated on YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: PhD work on receptor complexes. A 2026 press release names him David Cotnoir-White.

competitors.name: ArsenalBio
competitors.what: Programmable engineered T cell therapies with synthetic circuits
competitors.traction_then: Presented preclinical data on AB-1015 and AB-2100 at ASGCT in May 2023

technical_complexity.rationale: Designing novel synthetic receptors and delivery vehicles is research grade and needs lab validation.

defensibility.rationale: Novel receptor designs could be protected by IP, but no patent was verified in sources.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent took the wedge in sources found; the field shifted toward in vivo CAR-T by 2025 to 2026.

market_need_then: Cell therapy for solid tumors was an open unmet need; the company cites a market growing past 50B USD, a company claim.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious: the immune system had a blueprint all along

branding.brand_signature: The tagline about the immune system's blueprint

brand_strength.rationale: Hyphenated name that is hard to type; no press about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Modulari-T remains a preclinical company. In April 2026 it named Tanya Borsuk as CEO and moved the founder to President and CSO as it shifts to a partnership driven model. Equity funding is unverified; the only confirmed money is a small Canadian government grant.
notes: Aggregators list 500K pre-seed (Apr 2023) with YC, Pioneer Fund, Metaplanet; unverified, not recorded. Grant amount (130K CAD record, amended 2025) not recorded as a USD amount; grant fiscal quarter 2023-24 Q3 so date given as year only. The Business Wire release was not opened (fetch returned 403); CEO change comes from search snippets.
